description: A fresh character with every skill, in a Tristan with two blasters loaded with antimatter, an afterburner, a scrambler, a web, an armour repairer and five Hobgoblins, docked at Amamake II - Brutor Tribe Bureau. Stock EveJS's own commands and the loadout build it, so it builds in any tree.

steps.note: docks at Amamake II - Brutor Tribe Bureau; stock /dock goes back to the home station
